input.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation-of-liability, aggregate-liability or exclusion-of-damages provision anywhere: searches for "liability" return only the no-joint-venture language (p0061-p0062), and there is no "damages", indemnity or cap language. Section 9 (Warranties, p0055-p0058) and Section 10 (General Provisions) are silent on liability, so both Parties are exposed to unlimited direct and consequential damages. We therefore insert a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees payable under Section 3 or USD 1,000,000, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), with the Company's Section 3 payment obligations excluded from the cap. Placement in Section 9 also captures the two-year survival under Section 10.7.

proposal.summary: Add mutual liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000), mutual consequential-damages exclusion and uncapped Excluded Claims carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, leaving both Parties exposed to unlimited and consequential damages; we have added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees or USD 1,000,000 with a mutual exclusion of indirect damages. Confidentiality, data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations under Section 3 are not treated as capped damages; we can accept a straight 12-month fee cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct as a fallback.

ops.text: 9(c) Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3 in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000), and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligation to make payments under Section 3 shall not be considered damages subject to the foregoing limitation.
